name: Unjha Formulations Limited
about: Unjha Formulations Limited manufactures and sells ayurvedic products in India. The company offers sat-isabgol and isabgo husk formulation in elaichi flavor under the Anchor name; and isabgol powder in orange flavor under the Fibron, Fibron SF and Fibron SF (Sugar Free) names. It also exports its products. Unjha Formulations Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Sidhpur, India.
